PROP-e5782b58-pre-006.text: Registration must verify Discord guild membership and generation role before creating user.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-006.assertion: forall completeRegistration(token, user): user.in_guild(target_guild) AND user.has_role(generation_role)

locations.note: Checks Discord server membership (is_in_server) at line 96 and linked role (hasLinkedRole) at line 136 on every dashboard load. If not in server or lacking the role, user is gated. However this check occurs after login, not as part of the registration action itself.
Fetches Discord membership status via STEM Bot API with cache: 'no-store' to ensure freshness.
registerNewMember (the actual DB registration action) does NOT re-verify Discord guild membership or generation role — it only checks is_admin:false from session context.
